name: Arden Raynsford
source:
Height: 5'11"

Gentle natured and incredibly loyal, Arden serves in the King's Royal Guard. He adores Rivian and longs to protect him. Though quiet and kind, there seems to be another side of him lurking beneath the surface.

Hates: Treachery
Loves: Duels
